        "Read the complete new IDL and build-registration hunk. name(index) returns an ACString field name; value(index) returns unfolded AUTF8String data without field-specific interpretation or RFC2047 decoding. asRaw() has a separate whole-block contract and requires a trailing blank-line delimiter.",
        "The interface can represent raw native headers or synthesized protocol metadata. This row defines and registers the contract; it adds no implementation, consumer, direct test or proof of protocol conformance. Fixed accepted IDL retains the same contract and registration.",
        "The primary proposes a transport-neutral header object, discusses synthesized InternetMessageHeaders versus raw PR_TRANSPORT_MESSAGE_HEADERS and data-volume concerns. These proposals and attached examples do not establish complete header coverage or an implemented protocol adapter in this IDL-only phase.",
        "Full D280529 timeline and all seven actual inline bodies were read. The reviewer requests AUTF8String; the author first rebuts with RFC5322/field-specific decoding, then accepts the RFC5335 clarification and changes both value and asRaw. The exact original and accepted IDL use AUTF8String for those methods and ACString for name. Field-name ASCII limits are review rationale, not a validation algorithm implemented by this IDL.",
        "The author deliberately names IHeaderBlock without nsI and explains the intended scope beyond EWS. This accepted local interface name is not a global prefix ban. The requested e.g. punctuation is in the landed comment. The later reviewer request for non-ASCII tests and author test wishlist do not add tests to this interface-only row."
